people.name: Immer
people.line: A priestly division and its descendants.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Pashhur
people.line: Priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib

translations.web: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
translations.bsb: When Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer and the chief official in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
translations.kjv: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
translations.asv: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of Jehovah, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
